name: plugins
readme_excerpt: Plugins This repository contains a curated collection of Codex plugin examples. Each plugin lives under plugins/ / with a required .codex-plugin/plugin.json manifest and optional companion surfaces such as skills/, .app.json, .mcp.json, plugin-level agents/, commands/, hooks.json, assets/, and other supporting files. The default marketplace lives at .agents/plugins/marketplace.json and points at the standard plugins/ directory. API key login users have a separate marketplace at .agents/plugins/…
